name: Cross-Body Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat, fingertips beside your head.
Curl up and turn your right shoulder toward your left knee.
At the same time, draw the left knee in to meet it.
Lower slowly, then repeat to the other side.
cues: Lead with the shoulder, not elbow

common_mistakes.mistake: Yanking the neck with the hands
common_mistakes.fix: Fingertips only; keep space under the chin
Lift and turn the shoulder blade off the floor
Pause briefly when shoulder and knee meet
